```{r , echo=FALSE}
library(locuszoomr)
library(EnsDb.Hsapiens.v86)
library(ensembldb)
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
rad_meta_chr5 <- fread("/scratch1/tanxinli/GUAT/checkbim_impute/binary/meta-analysis/rsidlocuszoom/METAANALYSIS_nogc_nop_Rsq_filtering_flipped07271_locuszoom_rsid.txt")

colnames(rad_meta_chr5) <- c("chrom","pos","ID","effect_allele","other_allele","beta","se","p",
   "Direction",  "HetISq",   "HetChiSq" ,  "HetDf"  ,    "HetPVal"  ,  "rsid"   )

if (require(EnsDb.Hsapiens.v75)) {
loc <- locus(data = rad_meta_chr5, gene = 'RAD50', flank = 5e5,
             ens_db = "EnsDb.Hsapiens.v75")
summary(loc)
locus_plot(loc)
}


###GWAS plot
if (require(EnsDb.Hsapiens.v86)) {  # Use EnsDb.Hsapiens.v86 for hg38 build
  
  # Specify the locus around the reference SNP 'rs11955168'
  loc <- locus(data = rad_meta_chr5, labs="rsid", chrom="chrom", pos="pos", p="p", index_snp = "rs11955168",  flank = c(5e5,5e5), #+-500kb
               ens_db = "EnsDb.Hsapiens.v86")
  

  loc <-link_LD(loc,pop = "AMR", token="89c7356bd070") 
   loc <-link_recomb(loc, genome="hg19")
  # Plot the locus with LD information and recombination rate
  locus_plot(loc, labels=c("index","rs181273766","rs80094086","rs75929455" ),
             label_x = c(-18, 6, 19,-5))
}
```

##install("eQTpLot")
CONVERT GENE https://acribbs.github.io/blog/r-convert-a-ensembl-gene-id-to-gene-symbol/

https://acribbs.github.io/blog/r-convert-a-ensembl-gene-id-to-gene-symbol/
```{r , echo=FALSE}
library(eQTpLot)
rad_meta_chr5 <- fread("/scratch1/tanxinli/GUAT/checkbim_impute/binary/meta-analysis/rsidlocuszoom/METAANALYSIS_nogc_nop_Rsq_filtering_flipped07271_locuszoom_rsid.txt")

colnames(rad_meta_chr5) <- c("chrom","pos","ID","effect_allele","other_allele","beta","se","p",
   "Direction",  "HetISq",   "HetChiSq" ,  "HetDf"  ,    "HetPVal"  ,  "rsid"   )


#flip the beta:
rad_meta_chr5 <- rad_meta_chr5 %>%
  separate(ID, into = c("chr", "POS", "ref", "alt"), sep = ":", remove = FALSE) %>%
  select(-chr, -POS)
rad_meta_chr5[rad_meta_chr5$effect_allele != rad_meta_chr5$alt,'beta'] = -rad_meta_chr5[rad_meta_chr5$effect_allele != rad_meta_chr5$alt,'beta']

rad_meta_chr5 <-  rad_meta_chr5 %>% rename("CHR" ="chrom", "BP" ="pos","SNP" = "rsid","P"="p", "BETA"="beta") 
gwad.df <- rad_meta_chr5  %>% select(c("CHR", 'BP', 'SNP', 'BETA',  'P'))
 fwrite(gwad.df, "gwas.df.csv")
 gwad.df <- fread("gwas.df.csv")
#convert ENSG id to gene symbol 
https://acribbs.github.io/blog/r-convert-a-ensembl-gene-id-to-gene-symbol/
library(AnnotationDbi)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)

data = eqtl_3[,"gene_id"]
colnames(data) <- "ENSEMBL"
data$ENSEMBL <- gsub("\\.\\d+$", "", data$ENSEMBL)

data$ENSEMBL <- as.character(data$ENSEMBL)
data = as.vector(data)
keys_vector <- data[[1]] 

annots <- AnnotationDbi::select(org.Hs.eg.db, keys=keys_vector, 
                columns="SYMBOL", keytype="ENSEMBL")
annots  <- unique(annots )
eqtl_3$ENSEMBL <- gsub("\\.\\d+$", "", eqtl_3$gene_id)
result2 <- eqtl_3 %>% left_join(annots, by="ENSEMBL")
result2$SYMBOL[result2$ENSEMBL == "ENSG00000234290"] <- "IRF1"
result2$SYMBOL[result2$SYMBOL == "SEPT8"] <- "SEPTIN-8"
#SEPTIN8
result <- result2 %>% select(c("variant_id","SYMBOL","pval_nominal","slope"))
result$Tissue = "Whole_blood"
colnames(result) <- c("SNP.Id", "Gene.Symbol", "P.Value", "NES", "Tissue")
fwrite(result,"eqtl.df.csv")
```

          gbuild = "hg38",  trait = "ALL", tissue =  "Whole_blood", leadSNP="rs181273766")
